office_does: The prosecuting attorney prosecutes crimes for the state in the county and is legal advisor to the county commissioners and other county officials.
race_blurb: Uncontested: Prosecuting Attorney Randy J. Flyckt (prefers Republican), in office since 2003, is the only candidate.

candidates.summary: Adams County Prosecuting Attorney since 2003 and a former deputy prosecutor; the only candidate.
highlights: Says he works to keep the criminal justice system 'fair, effective, and impartial' [S1]
